person: Meera Halloran, specialist cardiology pharmacist at Moorbeck Infirmary, lives in Headingley, Leeds; helps care for her mum Kamala, 78, in Chapel Allerton

mail.subject: Appointment confirmed – Kamala Halloran
mail.body: Dear Ms Halloran, an appointment has been booked for Kamala Halloran with Dr Osei-Bonsu in 9 days at 14:00 for a medication review. Please bring a list of all current medicines, including anything bought over the counter.

mail.subject: Repeat prescription received
mail.body: We've received the repeat request for Kamala Halloran: bisoprolol 2.5mg, ramipril 5mg, furosemide 40mg, metformin 500mg and apixaban 5mg. Blister packs will be ready in 5 to 7 working days.

mail.subject: Prescription ready to collect
mail.body: Kamala Halloran's blister packs for the next 4 weeks are ready to collect. Apixaban was out of stock, so we owe 14 tablets and will email when they arrive. Open Mon–Fri 9:00–18:30, Sat 9:00–13:00, closed Sunday.

mail.subject: On-call swap confirmed
mail.body: Hi Meera, confirming your swap with Daniel Okafor: you're now on call in 5 days and again in 19 days, 08:00–16:30 in the dispensary. Daniel takes your Saturday shift in return.

mail.subject: Medicines safety committee – agenda
mail.body: Hi all, next week's committee (Wednesday 12:30) will cover the insulin incident review, the new anticoagulant chart and the omitted doses audit on Ward 14. Meera, could you present the audit, 10 minutes max? Lucia

mail.subject: Appointment letter: Kamala Halloran
mail.body: Mrs Kamala Halloran is booked to see Dr Haddad in the cardiology clinic, Outpatients B, in 7 days at 10:15. Please bring her current medication list and a record of daily weights for the past two weeks. Patient parking in the multi-storey is £3.20 for up to 2 hours, £5.80 for up to 4.

mail.subject: Mum's weights
mail.body: Hey sis, Mum read me her weights on the phone: she's up 1.5kg since last week and says her ankles are puffier. Worth raising with the heart people? R

mail.subject: Sunday call
mail.body: Can we push our Sunday call to 11 instead of 10? Football with the kids. Also I'll pay half the podiatry bill, just tell me what it comes to.

mail.subject: Care plan review
mail.body: Dear Meera, we'd like to review Kamala's care plan at her home in 18 days, 9:00–11:00, with our coordinator Bev Lockwood. From next month the morning visit rate rises from £24.50 to £26.00 per visit.

mail.subject: Home visit booked
mail.body: A podiatry home visit for Kamala Halloran is booked for two weeks tomorrow, with a 10:00–12:00 arrival window. The home visit fee is £48, payable by card on the day. Please make sure the room is warm.

mail.subject: Independent prescribing – study day 4
mail.body: Reminder: study day 4 is in 11 days, 9:30–16:30, Room G.14 in the Hartley Building. Please bring your portfolio log with at least 40 supervised hours signed off. Lunch is not provided.

mail.subject: Supervised hours
mail.body: Meera, I've signed off another 6 hours, so you're at 34 of the 40 you need. Shall we do a 3-hour block on Ward 14 this Friday afternoon and another on Monday? Femi

mail.subject: MOT booking
mail.body: Your MOT for the blue hatchback, reg YK19 PDR, is booked for Thursday week at 13:30. It takes about 45 minutes and you're welcome to wait. MOT fee £54.85. Your current certificate expires in 13 days.

mail.subject: my 40th!!
mail.body: You're coming Saturday right?! 7pm at The Lantern Rooms. Dress code is 'something gold'. No presents please, but if you insist I'm collecting for the hospice.

mail.subject: conference Friday week
mail.body: Still up for the Northern Clinical Pharmacy conference on Friday week? I've booked us both on the 7:42. Our poster slot is 14:00–14:45 in the Exhibition Hall, and badges can be collected from 8:30 at the north entrance.

mail.subject: Your e-tickets from Grace Adeyemi
mail.body: Outbound Leeds 07:42 → Manchester Deansgate Cross 08:35, coach C seat 41. Return Manchester Deansgate Cross 18:10 → Leeds 19:05, coach B seat 12. Off-peak return £31.60, paid by Grace Adeyemi.

mail.subject: Your registration
mail.body: Welcome, Meera Halloran! Your registration ref is NCP-2611-0473. Doors open 8:30, opening plenary 9:30. Lunch is included; tell us about dietary needs by replying at least 5 days before the conference. Your poster board number is P-27.

mail.subject: Owed item arrived
mail.body: The 14 apixaban 5mg tablets owed for Kamala Halloran have arrived and are waiting with her blister packs.

mail.subject: Blood test request
mail.body: Dr Osei-Bonsu has requested blood tests for Kamala Halloran (kidney function and HbA1c). This needs to be a fasting test: no food after midnight, water is fine.

mail.subject: After today's review
mail.body: Following Kamala's review today, Dr Osei-Bonsu has changed furosemide to 40mg in the morning and 20mg at lunchtime, starting tomorrow. A new prescription has gone to Thornhill Pharmacy. Please weigh her daily and call us if she gains more than 2kg in 3 days.

mail.subject: book club – next pick
mail.body: Next book club is at mine a fortnight today at 7. We're doing The Salt Orchard by Ines Varga. Efua's bringing dessert, could you do a salad?

mail.subject: Class pack
mail.body: Thanks Meera, your 8-class pack is active. You've used 5 classes and 3 remain. The pack expires in 30 days.

mail.subject: Your water bill
mail.body: Your half-yearly water bill is £212.36, due in 14 days. Pay online with customer number 7740 1182 or set up a direct debit.

mail.subject: dinner?
mail.body: Bar Ostra on Wednesday week? I've booked 6pm under Ashworth. They do a set menu for £32 a head.

mail.subject: Payslip available
mail.body: Your payslip is available. Net pay £2,894.17, including one on-call weekend supplement of £186.00.

mail.subject: Hearing aid repair
mail.body: Kamala's left hearing aid has been repaired under warranty at no charge. It will be posted to her within 5 working days. It takes size 312 batteries and we've included two packs.

mail.subject: Heart failure nurse review – Kamala
mail.body: Hi Meera, I've booked Kamala in with me in 20 days at 14:30 in the Heart Failure Clinic. If her weight keeps creeping up before then, ring the HF line on 0113 496 0721, weekdays 9 to 5.

mail.subject: omitted doses audit data
mail.body: Here's the Ward 14 data: 312 doses audited, 23 omitted, 9 of those with no recorded reason. Can you double-check the 9 before committee?

mail.subject: thanks for the swap!
mail.body: You're a star, I owe you a coffee and a Saturday. For your on-call days the bleep is 4417 and the dispensary door code is 2580.

mail.subject: lift to book club?
mail.body: Want a lift to Mariana's next week? I can pick you up from yours at 6:40.

mail.subject: Visit change
mail.body: Due to staff sickness, Kamala's evening visit tomorrow will be at 19:30 instead of 18:00. Her morning visit is unchanged at 8:00. Sorry for any inconvenience. Bev

mail.subject: tomorrow
mail.body: Darling what time are you collecting me tomorrow for the heart doctor? I'll have my coat on. Shall I bring my weight book? Love Mum

mail.subject: Order for Kamala Halloran
mail.body: Your order for delivery to 14 Elmfield Grove is confirmed for Friday, 16:00–17:00. Total £46.80. Substitutions allowed.

mail.subject: FY1 teaching Friday
mail.body: Thanks for doing the prescribing safety session for the FY1s on Friday. There'll be 18 of them. Could you include a bit on apixaban dosing in renal impairment? The room's booked till 16:00.

mail.subject: Transport request declined
mail.body: We're unable to provide transport for Kamala Halloran's cardiology appointment as she does not meet the eligibility criteria. Please make your own arrangements.

mail.subject: Annual renewal due
mail.body: Your annual registration renewal is due in 21 days. The fee is £257, and you'll also need to submit your revalidation records.

mail.subject: Re: agenda
mail.body: Quick change: committee is in Seminar Room 5 today, Room 3 has a leak. Still 12:30.

mail.subject: pills
mail.body: Darling the pink ones in the afternoon slot look different this week, is that right? Love Mum

mail.subject: Christmas rota requests
mail.body: Please send your Christmas and New Year requests within 10 days. We can approve up to two days off per person over the period.

mail.subject: New prescription received
mail.body: We've received a new prescription from Allerton Lane for Kamala Halloran: furosemide 20mg, one at lunchtime. We're adding it to her blister packs, so please allow until tomorrow afternoon before collecting.

Video call with Rohan re Mum

reminders.title: Collect Mum's blister packs from Thornhill
Write Mum's current medicines list for cardiology
Tell the conference about my dietary needs
Check portfolio log is signed off
Pick up gold dress from the tailor
